title: Bedast Hua Naher Pa Saqqae Sakina
body:
Roro ke baya.n karte they runme shahe waala as
Be dust hua neher pa saqqae sakeena sa
1.Abbas as ke laashe pa ye kehte they shahe dee.n.
Marne tere meri kamar tooti hai bhayya.
<<DIVIDER>>
2.Khaegi sakeena sa meri zaalim ke tamaache
Tapkega lahoo kano.n se jal jaega kurta.
<<DIVIDER>>
3.Seene pa sina khaega hum shakle payamber saws.
Kuch deir me hojaega shabbir as akela.
<<DIVIDER>>
4.Maa fatema zahra sa ko rulaega lahad me.
Ghode se zamee.n par wo tera moo.n ke bal aana.
<<DIVIDER>>
5.Khanjar tha rawa.n gardan e shabbir as pa jisdum.
Shabbir as ne Abbas as ko roro ke pukara.
<<DIVIDER>>
6.Bole shahe wala as aey sakeena as meri beti.
Dariya ke kanare tera ammu gaya maara.
<<DIVIDER>>
7.Ruq karke suwe neher ye Zainab as ne sada di.
Tum hi tow muhafiz meri chaadar ke they bhayya.
<<DIVIDER>>
8.Qaimon me alam aaya jo Abbas as ka aarif
Shabbir as ke lab par yehi noha tha khudara.
